author_note: Read only the 13 contracts in workflows/*.yaml and scripts/workflow_registry.py (the output folder was listed once to confirm it exists; no other file was opened, and no model or assistant code was run). Each gold follows from quoted contract text: DO when a workflow's inputs, sample minimums, size limits and exposed control ranges are all met; PARTIAL (a) when a named workflow is asked for a setting it does not expose (PUMA has no controls; OTTER has no sparsity parameter), PARTIAL (b) when one of two requested results is produced and the other is produced by no workflow (three-layer DRAGON, causal networks, outcome prediction); DECLINE when one stated condition fails (LIONESS-DRAGON 20,000,000-value limit computed as F(F-1)/2 x samples with F the features of both layers, three-sample minimums, BONOBO delta < 1/3 with sparsify, OTTER lam in [0, 1], COBRA more genes than samples, COBRA artifact not a LIONESS handoff, no clustering from expression); ASK when exactly one fact (somatic vs germline, regulator class, granularity, wiring vs activity, layer count, panel size, QC'd sample count, log-transformation, paired samples, causal need, continuous vs binarized values) moves the outcome between two contract outcomes; CLARIFY when no result is named. Arithmetic was recomputed by hand and every evidence quote was checked as a verbatim substring of the named file. Items were written per class and form, then shuffled with fixed seeds (single: random.Random(20261023), multi: random.Random(1023)) before ids were assigned.
review_note: Independent gold review. I read only AUTHOR-BRIEF.md (for the call definitions and required counts), items-author.json, the 13 contracts in workflows/*.yaml and scripts/workflow_registry.py (controls, ranges, conditions, OUTSIDE/UNSUPPORTED notes and selection axes); no other file was opened and no model or assistant code was run. For every item I re-derived the call from the prompt as written against the contract text: required inputs, sample minimums (three for LIONESS-*, BONOBO and DRAGON; two for COBRA, GIRAFFE and OTTER expression), COBRA genes > samples, SAMBAR 2 <= kmin <= kmax <= samples, exposed-control ranges (OTTER lam in [0, 1], DRAGON/LIONESS-DRAGON lambdas both in [0, 1], BONOBO delta below 1/3 with sparsify), unregistered handoffs, and the LIONESS-DRAGON 20,000,000-value cap recomputed as F(F-1)/2 x samples with F the features of both layers. I checked PARTIAL against the brief's two shapes only, ASK items for one deciding fact whose two answers give different outcomes (and whether a default or file check settles it), CLARIFY items for the absence of a concrete result, the three minimal pairs (word-level diff: one key fact each, calls differ) and two paraphrase pairs (same call), each multi-turn script against its type (option-word vs natural answers, volunteered condition, correction to the other side, switch request with its own gold, two distinct unknown replies) and its match_keywords, every evidence string as a verbatim substring of the named file, and ASCII-only text. All golds were confirmed; two scripted replies were edited (one natural-form answer that reused an option word, one reply that contradicted its own turn-1 sample type, with the matching final_reason wording). Changes and kept borderline cases are listed in GOLD-REVIEW.md.
